parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the trashcan is made of stainless steel, circular in shape, and fits on top of the can.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the trashcan to contain odors and conceal waste. It opens when the foot pad is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge when the foot pedal is pressed and returns to a closed position when released.

parts.name: Foot Pad
parts.Basic_description: The foot pad is a small rectangular plastic component located at the base front of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to open the lid hands-free by pressing it with their foot.
parts.Movement_description: It moves downward when pressed, activating a lever mechanism that lifts the lid.

parts.name: Handle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The handle is a small metallic loop attached to the back or side of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to lift or move the trashcan easily.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed but can be grasped and pulled to reposition the trashcan.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the trashcan made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the trash bag and provides structural support for the lid and pedal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main housing for all other parts.
